campaign.title: M1 lower post-collar joint height-alias gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: This is an exact internal transform gate. Any imported Poisson, stationary-phase, two-dimensional exponential-sum, large-sieve, or trace estimate must be stated with its exact hypotheses, absolute-value placement, endpoint uniformity, coefficient class, and full R-power ledger before use.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact complementary displacement tail left by Round 139 be carried through a complete height-dependent character-Poisson formula into a genuinely joint signed height-alias scalar and bounded by R X^epsilon; if not, what is the first exact cutoff, endpoint, transition, rank-one, resonant-ray, product-fibre, self-return, or capacity obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Let R=X^(1/4), y=floor(sqrt X), N=floor X=y^2+q, 0<=q<=2y, L_h=floor(rho y/sqrt(h)), and D_h=y-L_h-1. For fixed 0<rho<1/8, the literal positive tail is S_N=sum_(h>=1)h^(-1)sum_(1<=d<=D_h)chi_4(d)V_low(4R^2h^2/d^2)e(Nh/d), with an empty row when D_h<1 and the negative sign its conjugate. In character-Poisson variables r=tau-4k, an interior stationary point is x_*=2sqrt(Nh/r), and x_*<=D_h is exactly r>=4Nh/D_h^2, equivalently s=r-4h>=4h(N-D_h^2)/D_h^2. The clean principal phase would be e(sqrt(Nh(4h+s))), but no principal-only replacement is granted.
quantities: The cutoff is height-dependent and integer: the exact tail is 1<=d<=D_h=y-floor(rho y/sqrt(h))-1, with every empty, hard, and equality case retained.

Character Poisson must retain both mod-four branches, the literal half-endpoint term, all dual integrals, nonstationary modes, stationary entry and exit, profile crossings, incomplete-Fresnel transitions, and remainders.
For r=4h+s, the exact stationary-entry displacement is 4h(N-D_h^2)/D_h^2, which is of order sqrt(h) only after a uniform floor and q ledger.
The principal phase sqrt(Nhr) is homogeneous of degree one in (h,r); any claimed two-dimensional curvature gain must confront its rank-one Hessian and coherent rational rays.
The exact phase-one radical channel is already target-safe, but near radicals, product fibres, transition modes, and the aggregate over rays remain open.
The literal tail has y^(1+o(1)) absolute scalar capacity versus target R=y^(1/2); the full stationary principal family has R^(3/2+o(1)) absolute capacity.
Round 139 gives scalar target equivalence only. No tail-square identity or deletion from the Round-138 residual may be inferred.

completion_criteria: Derive the height-dependent tail cutoff and complete character-Poisson formula with both signs, mod-four branches, floors, empty rows, half-endpoints, profiles, and zero extensions exact.
Prove the exact stationary-entry map r=4h+s and price the floor, q, transition-width, nonstationary, crossing, and remainder owners uniformly over every active height.
Analyze the joint signed height-alias scalar before any rowwise or aliaswise modulus, including the Hessian rank, coherent rays, product fibres, exact and near radicals, and actual h^(-1) weight.
Return every proposed estimate to the R X^epsilon scalar target with a complete dyadic capacity ledger; a transform identity or positive energy alone is not a gain.
Close under exactly one label: target_bound, strict_height_alias_reduction, or height_alias_no_go.
Make no lower-GAR, direct blockwise M1, M9-M1, M2, endpoint, M9, quarter, or exponent promotion unless every corresponding owner closes.

closing_assessment.main_result: The literal sharp post-collar tail at rho_1 is target-equivalent to one clean signed far height-alias scalar at rho_2. Two-collar smoothing, the complete ramp, all nonstationary modes, profile crossings, and stationary remainders are target-safe. The grouped survivor has an exact incomplete divisor coefficient, rank-one phase, matching R^(3/2) coefficient-blind capacity, target-safe exact radicals, and an open near-radical/nonsquare cancellation problem.

review_seams.requirement: The displacement complement is exactly the integer interval 1<=d<=D_h, including every floor, empty row, profile sample, parity, and sign.
The character-Poisson identity retains the hard half-endpoint, both mod-four branches, all dual modes, profiles, zero extensions, and convergence convention.
The r=4h+s boundary is derived exactly with its q, floor, equality, transition, and support ledgers.
Any joint height-alias gain confronts Hessian rank, rational rays, product fibres, exact and near radicals, and the actual character and weights.
Every owner returns to the R scalar target before modulus; no invertible transform, positive energy, or principal-only family substitutes for the tail.
No tail-square identity or downstream M1, M2, M9, quarter, or exponent promotion is inferred without its separate owner.
